paragraphs.text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone;
paragraphs.original: Διὸ μηκέτι στέγοντες εὐδοκήσαμεν καταλειφθῆναι ἐν Ἀθήναις μόνοι,
paragraphs.translit: Dio mēketi stegontes eudokēsamen kataleiphthēnai en Athēnais monoi,

paragraphs.text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God`s minister in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort [you] concerning your faith;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπέμψαμεν Τιμόθεον, τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν καὶ συνεργὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλέσαι ὑπὲρ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν
paragraphs.translit: kai epempsamen Timotheon, ton adelphon hēmōn kai synergon tou theou en tō euangeliō tou Christou, eis to stērixai hymas kai parakalesai hyper tēs pisteōs hymōn

paragraphs.text: that no man be moved by these afflictions; for yourselves know that hereunto we are appointed.
paragraphs.original: τὸ μηδένα σαίνεσθαι ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν ταύταις. αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο κείμεθα·
paragraphs.translit: to mēdena sainesthai en tais thlipsesin tautais. autoi gar oidate hoti eis touto keimetha·

paragraphs.text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἦμεν, προελέγομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι μέλλομεν θλίβεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ ἐγένετο καὶ οἴδατε.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar hote pros hymas ēmen, proelegomen hymin hoti mellomen thlibesthai, kathōs kai egeneto kai oidate.

paragraphs.text: For this cause I also, when I could no longer forbear, sent that I might know your faith, lest by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor should be in vain.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο κἀγὼ μηκέτι στέγων ἔπεμψα εἰς τὸ γνῶναι τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν, μή πως ἐπείρασεν ὑμᾶς ὁ πειράζων καὶ εἰς κενὸν γένηται ὁ κόπος ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto kagō mēketi stegōn epempsa eis to gnōnai tēn pistin hymōn, mē pōs epeirasen hymas ho peirazōn kai eis kenon genētai ho kopos hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: But when Timothy came even now unto us from you, and brought us glad tidings of your faith and love, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, longing to see us, even as we also [to see] you;
paragraphs.original: Ἄρτι δὲ ἐλθόντος Τιμοθέου πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀφʼ ὑμῶν καὶ εὐαγγελισαμένου ἡμῖν τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ὑμῶν, καὶ ὅτι ἔχετε μνείαν ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴν πάντοτε ἐπιποθοῦντες ἡμᾶς ἰδεῖν καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: Arti de elthontos Timotheou pros hēmas aphʼ hymōn kai euangelisamenou hēmin tēn pistin kai tēn agapēn hymōn, kai hoti echete mneian hēmōn agathēn pantote epipothountes hēmas idein kathaper kai hēmeis hymas,

paragraphs.text: for this cause, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith:
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο παρεκλήθημεν, ἀδελφοί, ἐφʼ ὑμῖν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ ἀνάγκῃ καὶ θλίψει ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως,
paragraphs.translit: dia touto pareklēthēmen, adelphoi, ephʼ hymin epi pasē tē anankē kai thlipsei hēmōn dia tēs hymōn pisteōs,

paragraphs.text: for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι νῦν ζῶμεν ἐὰν ὑμεῖς στήκετε ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: hoti nyn zōmen ean hymeis stēkete en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: For what thanksgiving can we render again unto God for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
paragraphs.original: τίνα γὰρ εὐχαριστίαν δυνάμεθα τῷ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ χαρᾷ ᾗ χαίρομεν διʼ ὑμᾶς ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: tina gar eucharistian dynametha tō theō antapodounai peri hymōn epi pasē tē chara hē chairomen diʼ hymas emprosthen tou theou hēmōn,

paragraphs.text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
paragraphs.original: νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ δεόμενοι εἰς τὸ ἰδεῖν ὑμῶν τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ καταρτίσαι τὰ ὑστερήματα τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν;
paragraphs.translit: nyktos kai hēmeras hyperekperissou deomenoi eis to idein hymōn to prosōpon kai katartisai ta hysterēmata tēs pisteōs hymōn;

paragraphs.text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way unto you:
paragraphs.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ ἡμῶν καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς κατευθύναι τὴν ὁδὸν ἡμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: Autos de ho theos kai patēr hēmōn kai ho kyrios hēmōn Iēsous kateuthynai tēn hodon hēmōn pros hymas·

paragraphs.text: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also [do] toward you;
paragraphs.original: ὑμᾶς δὲ ὁ κύριος πλεονάσαι καὶ περισσεύσαι τῇ ἀγάπῃ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας, καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: hymas de ho kyrios pleonasai kai perisseusai tē agapē eis allēlous kai eis pantas, kathaper kai hēmeis eis hymas,

paragraphs.text: to the end he may establish your hearts unblameable in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ἀμέμπτους ἐν ἁγιωσύνῃ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: eis to stērixai hymōn tas kardias amemptous en hagiōsynē emprosthen tou theou kai patros hēmōn en tē parousia tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou meta pantōn tōn hagiōn autou.
